summary: ORB settled-rules census. Scope verified by diff, not by the PR text: exactly scripts/orb_operator_filter_census.py and tests/unit/test_orb_operator_filter_census.py, +1221/-18; git diff --name-only against base returns nothing outside those two, so no ORB service, OMS, strategy, broker, intent, config or deploy path is touched. V1 THREE DECLARED KINDS: DAY_GATE/LIVE/POST_FILL_SELL constants at :47-49, and EVERY emitted check is prefixed with its kind (DAY_GATE:R1=, LIVE:R3_MACD_HISTOGRAM=, POST_FILL_SELL:R4=). The report header states the taxonomy in prose as well. V2 GATE ONCE: run_settled_name_day calls evaluate_day_gate once at the top, anchored to at_et(day,9,30), and returns immediately with no live rows when not ELIGIBLE — it is the only day-kill path. V3 A PULL IS TEMPORARY:  is REASSIGNED every bar, so a pull scopes to one interval and a later bar re-arms; verified live on IMRN 2026-09-04 which reads PULL 09:31, PULL 09:32, ARM 09:33, FILL 09:33, SELL 09:34. V4 FILL THEN SELL: evaluate_post_fill takes the fill as an argument and runs only after the FILL LiveDecision is recorded; body>=threshold -> HOLD, below -> first_executable_bid -> SELL with the realised bid (IMRN exit 1.8500, return -0.54%). V5 NO FUTURE DATA: decision_at documents that a 09:30 bar is observable at 09:31:00, the armed interval starts at that time, quote_is_known_by and body_measurement_at bound the reads, and the header states 'a LIVE decision can affect only later prints'. Pinned by test_body_measurement_never_reads_a_trade_after_its_decision_time and test_future_atr_state_cannot_reject_an_earlier_break. V6 PARAMETERS: DEFAULT_BODY_THRESHOLD_PCT = Decimal('45') and DEFAULT_BODY_MEASUREMENT_DELAY = 'bar-close', both CLI-overridable. ⛔ 45% IS UNCHANGED, which is correct — the operator ruled that no rule moves on backtest evidence until real fills validate it. V7 SAME TAPE + DAIC NAMED: legacy evaluate_break is retained and scored on the same loaded tape; R2/R6/R7 appear ONLY inside evaluate_break (legacy) and nowhere in the settled path. MY OWN MUTATIONS, not codex's, all RED then restored 24/24: (1) making a LIVE pull permanent kills test_live_pull_is_temporary_and_a_later_bar_can_arm_and_fill — this is the DAIC-class defect and it has its own control; (2) inverting the R4 body comparison -> 3 RED; (3) anchoring the gate to 09:35 instead of the 09:30 close -> 8 RED; (4) letting a FAILED gate proceed -> test_four_red_runup_is_a_day_gate_not_a_live_pull RED. I RE-RAN THE CENSUS MYSELF rather than accept the reported figures, and every one reproduces: legacy 7/107 PASS (identical to my own baseline run of the pre-PR census); volume-baseline gate 10/23, candidates 7/10, priced 4/7, unanswerable 3/7, SELL 2/4, HOLD 2/4; absolute-levels gate 5/23, candidates 5/5, priced 3/5, unanswerable 2/5, SELL 1/3, HOLD 2/3; coverage 2026-08-24 through 2026-09-04, 10/10 requested days, unreachable none. DAIC 2026-08-25 is rendered as an explicitly named control and is ELIGIBLE -> ARM -> FILL at 3.8600 -> HOLD on a 54.94% body under BOTH assignments — the +37% trade the legacy filter killed with R6 CHOPPY as its sole reason now survives. CONTROLLED PAIR against this PR's own base: base 46 failed / 3250 passed, head 46 failed / 3262 passed, delta +12, failure sets DIFFED BY NAME and IDENTICAL. Codex reported 55/3241 and 55/3253 — a different platform count but the SAME +12 delta, the same environment gap recorded on the #898 and #902 pins. ⚠ ONE THING THE OPERATOR MUST DECIDE, NOT A DEFECT: the two look-back assignments diverge enormously. Absolute-levels (RSI and Stoch >= 50 at 09:30) halves gate eligibility 10/23 -> 5/23 and in the daily traces kills nearly every name outright, because the >=50 FLOORS ARE NOT IN THE OPERATOR'S SPEC — his rule is direction only, 'RSI up' and 'Stoch K up'. Codex correctly reports both and selects neither. DAIC survives under both, so the control is robust to the choice. NOT COVERED BY THIS PIN: this is a SIMULATED census with no realised control and no size qualification — the header says so itself. It validates the RULE STRUCTURE against the operator's spec; it does not validate the 45% threshold, the look-back assignment, or any strategy edge.
